introduction: ERC-1155 is a multi-token standard that enables a single contract to manage multiple token types, both fungible and non-fungible, within one deployment. Proposed by Witek Radomski of Enjin, it was designed to be more gas-efficient than deploying separate ERC-20 and ERC-721 contracts. ERC-1155 supports batch operations, allowing multiple token transfers in a single transaction, which dramatically reduces gas costs. Each token type is identified by a unique uint256 ID.
designPurpose: ERC-1155 was designed to address the inefficiency of deploying separate contracts for each token type. In gaming and metaverse applications, a single project may need thousands of different items (weapons, armor, currencies), and deploying individual contracts for each is prohibitively expensive. ERC-1155 consolidates them into one contract while supporting batch transfers and balance queries for maximum gas efficiency.
commonUsage: ERC-1155 is widely used in blockchain gaming (Enjin, The Sandbox), digital collectibles, and any application requiring multiple token types. It is ideal for gaming inventories where items can be both unique (legendary sword #1) and fungible (100 gold coins). Marketplaces like OpenSea support ERC-1155 alongside ERC-721 for multi-edition digital art and collectibles.
fn.balanceOf.desc: Returns the balance of a specific token type for a given account. Each token type is identified by its unique uint256 ID.
fn.balanceOf.params.account: The address to query the balance of.
fn.balanceOf.params.id: The ID of the token type to query.
fn.balanceOf.returns.balance: The number of tokens of the specified type held by the account.
fn.balanceOfBatch.desc: Returns the balances of multiple account/token-type pairs in a single call. Arrays must be the same length.
fn.balanceOfBatch.params.accounts: Array of addresses to query balances for.
fn.balanceOfBatch.params.ids: Array of token type IDs corresponding to each account.
fn.balanceOfBatch.returns.balances: Array of balances corresponding to each account/ID pair.
fn.safeTransferFrom.desc: Transfers a specified amount of a single token type from one address to another. If the recipient is a contract, onERC1155Received must be called and return the correct magic value.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.from: The address to transfer tokens from.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.to: The address to transfer tokens to.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.id: The ID of the token type to transfer.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.amount: The number of tokens to transfer.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.data: Additional data passed to the receiver callback, with no specified format.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.desc: Transfers multiple token types in a single transaction. The ids and amounts arrays must have the same length. Calls onERC1155BatchReceived if the recipient is a contract.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.params.from: The address to transfer tokens from.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.params.to: The address to transfer tokens to.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.params.ids: Array of token type IDs to transfer.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.params.amounts: Array of amounts for each token type.
fn.safeBatchTransferFrom.params.data: Additional data passed to the receiver callback.
fn.setApprovalForAll.desc: Grants or revokes permission for an operator to transfer all of the caller's tokens of any type.
fn.setApprovalForAll.params.operator: The address to grant or revoke operator approval for.
fn.setApprovalForAll.params.approved: True to approve the operator, false to revoke.
fn.isApprovedForAll.desc: Returns whether an operator is approved to manage all tokens of a given account.
fn.isApprovedForAll.returns.approved: True if the operator is approved for all token types of the account.
fn.uri.desc: Returns the URI for a given token type ID. The URI may contain the string '{id}' which clients must replace with the actual token ID in lowercase hexadecimal.
fn.uri.params.id: The token type ID to get the URI for.
fn.uri.returns.uri: The URI string for the token metadata.
fn.TransferSingle.desc: Emitted when a single token type is transferred, minted, or burned.
fn.TransferSingle.params.operator: The address that initiated the transfer (msg.sender).
fn.TransferSingle.params.from: The address tokens are transferred from (address(0) for minting).
fn.TransferSingle.params.to: The address tokens are transferred to (address(0) for burning).
fn.TransferSingle.params.id: The ID of the token type transferred.
fn.TransferBatch.desc: Emitted when multiple token types are transferred in a batch operation.
fn.TransferBatch.params.operator: The address that initiated the batch transfer.
fn.TransferBatch.params.from: The address tokens are transferred from.
fn.TransferBatch.params.to: The address tokens are transferred to.
fn.TransferBatch.params.ids: Array of token type IDs transferred.
fn.TransferBatch.params.values: Array of amounts for each token type.
fn.ApprovalForAll.desc: Emitted when an account grants or revokes operator approval for all token types.
fn.ApprovalForAll.params.account: The account granting or revoking approval.
fn.ApprovalForAll.params.approved: True if approved, false if revoked.
sim.singleTransfer.name: Single Token Transfer
sim.singleTransfer.desc: Transfer a specific amount of one token type from one address to another using safeTransferFrom.
sim.singleTransfer.step.call: The operator calls safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, amount, data) to initiate a single token type transfer.
sim.singleTransfer.step.balanceUpdate: The contract updates the balances mapping: decrements the sender's balance and increments the recipient's balance for the specified token ID.
sim.singleTransfer.step.receiverCheck: If the recipient is a contract, the ERC-1155 contract calls onERC1155Received() and verifies the returned magic value.
sim.singleTransfer.step.event: A TransferSingle event is emitted and the tokens are delivered to the recipient.
sim.batchTransfer.name: Batch Token Transfer
sim.batchTransfer.desc: Transfer multiple token types in a single transaction using safeBatchTransferFrom for maximum gas efficiency.
sim.batchTransfer.step.call: The operator calls safeBatchTransferFrom with arrays of token IDs [1, 2, 3] and amounts [10, 5, 1] to transfer multiple token types at once.
sim.batchTransfer.step.multiBalance: The contract iterates through all IDs and updates each balance pair. All sender balances decrease and all recipient balances increase in a single transaction.
sim.batchTransfer.step.callback: The contract calls onERC1155BatchReceived on the recipient contract, passing all IDs and amounts for batch verification.
sim.batchTransfer.step.event: A TransferBatch event is emitted containing all transferred token IDs and amounts.
